_: The tier-2 desk toy, 'Absent is not zero' (DECISIONS.md CR-19). Every desk string the toy prints, every number format it copies and every desk limit it draws with is READ from the desk's own code at build time by scripts/tier2_desk_toy.py. A value that cannot be found fails the tier-2 build, so the page cannot ship a claim the desk no longer makes. Paths are relative to deskRoot. If a desk line moves or is reworded, edit `find` here after checking the new wording still says the same thing - never the script, and never the page.
_limits: Numbers the toy draws with. `ast` reads a class field's default; `regex` reads the first capture group. Emitted as data attributes on the toy, so the drawing and the printed check use the same value.
_text: Words the toy prints exactly as `show`. `find` is the literal that must exist in `file`, and `show` must be part of `find`, so what is shown is provably the desk's own wording.

noPrints.find: return "no trade prints on this feed"
noPrints.show: no trade prints on this feed

readUp.find: read="Momentum flipped up after an extended slide lower."
readUp.show: Momentum flipped up after an extended slide lower.

readDown.find: read="Momentum flipped down after an extended push higher."
readDown.show: Momentum flipped down after an extended push higher.

_formats: The desk's own format strings. `find` must exist in `file`, and it is also the template the toy fills: {name:+.3f} means a sign and three decimals, exactly as Python formats it; {name} with no spec is a Python float as str() prints it.
_rules: Lines that back a claim the toy makes about the desk's behaviour. Nothing here is printed on the page; each is a tripwire, and a miss fails the build like any other. `claim` is what the line proves.
